prior_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah still carries the map and plans to copy it, Father William added the witch's home and the Barrow Mound to it, and the party plans to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow. The treasure is still unfound.

George answered where the lair is and warned the dragon will soon fly (beat_63). Father William and George established that it reportedly can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_54, beat_66), which changes the shape of the hunt. The dragon and the reward remain open.

The Clurichen Naggeneen was caught and revealed as a drinker who empties bars (beat_20, beat_21), so the question is answered and the nightly threat ended. He still hangs captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_26), and his offer of a pot of gold or a secret for release remains.
Lady Hilda was only seen dining. Sir Phidipaldi's promise to come back and hire her is unreleased.
Shipments still had not come in the next morning, and the cause is unknown.
Ned was only seen at the tavern, and his offer stands unanswered.
Dunk offered 20 gold, and Gill said he would go lower than 100 only once his sons return (beat_3), renegotiating the terms.
The bar thief was caught (beat_20, beat_23) and Quinn paid the reward of 33 gold each (beat_25), so nothing remains open.

new_threads.name: Squints and the Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints on stated terms, including second pick after the first treasure (beat_42), and later put Brother Dirk under him (beat_90). Those terms remain live, as does Trout's secret plan not to rescue him.

new_threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
new_threads.reason: Dunk found a glowing magical mithril shirt in Warwick's shop and says he has a plan to get it (beat_46). It might help against the dragon, but no purpose was stated that makes it a child of the hunt.

new_threads.name: Ingrid's sleeping potion
new_threads.reason: Dunk and Ingrid arranged a sleeping potion for Warwick. Dunk fetched and diluted the faun wine and handed it over (beat_72, beat_78), and Ingrid is now brewing it with a meeting set for tonight (beat_79). Her secret, which Dunk holds over her (beat_38), is part of this one bargain.

new_threads.name: Brandon's sword at the Barrow
new_threads.reason: Father William states the dragon can't be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_54), giving the trip a stated purpose under the hunt. The party set out to get it (beat_51).

new_threads.name: Uriah's penance for Father William
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah promised penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation. Neither has been done yet.

new_threads.name: The giant in the woods
new_threads.reason: The party robbed the giant of its captive and fled, but the giant still lives in its cottage on the route north. Escaping did not end the danger.

standalone_beats.reason: Trout identified the adventurers at the Clumsy Fox, including Malzatarik, with no thread developed.
Trout's catch fed the tavern but led nowhere lasting.
Ingrid's wares are a general resource tied to no thread.
Father William's standing offer to heal Uriah is useful but tied to no thread.
The search of the church found nothing.
Ingrid's report of fairies encroaching and her friend Vivian in the forest is background that touches no thread.
Uriah bought wolfsbane and mandrake tea, gaining resources outside any thread.

shared_subjects.subject: Naggeneen captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar and his offer for release
shared_subjects.reason: The Clurichen thread is about Naggeneen himself, while Quinn's job is finished.

shared_subjects.subject: Farmer Gill's sons out hunting the dragon
shared_subjects.reason: Their fate is already an open question on the dragon thread, and the mule price waits on their return.

shared_subjects.subject: The party's map carried by Dr. Uriah, now marking the witch's home and the Barrow
shared_subjects.reason: The map thread is about the map itself.

shared_subjects.subject: Location and distance of Brandon's Barrow Mound
shared_subjects.reason: The sword trip is where the party would use the Barrow's location first.

shared_subjects.subject: Legend that only Brandon's magic sword can kill the dragon
shared_subjects.reason: The thread about the sword comes before the broader hunt.

shared_subjects.subject: Brother Dirk's intentions after his rescue
shared_subjects.reason: Dirk was on the sword errand, and whether he continues it bears first on that trip.

shared_subjects.subject: Warwick's magical mithril chain shirt
shared_subjects.reason: The thread about the shirt itself comes before the dragon hunt it might aid.

shared_subjects.subject: The sleeping potion Ingrid is brewing
shared_subjects.reason: The potion is the subject of Dunk's bargain with Ingrid, though it serves his plan for the shirt.
